Source: DAQuester recording, Awesome, DATester 7.41, 2026-10-09. Server dialog packets and sanitized selections. Numeric input text omitted. Completion status opcode was not recorded by the old build.

Dialog.Name: Riona
Dialog.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Dialog.Name: Riona
Dialog.Text: You recall your mundane birth? That is good. But be warned that once you recall your mundane birth it cannot be altered, except by realizing that many of your memories are false (( -100,000 Experience! )).

Dialog.Name: Riona
Dialog.Text: Do you know about the town in which you spent most of your mundane years? It must be close to one of the known towns of Eastern Temuair: Abel, Mileth, Piet, Rucesion, Suomi, or Undine. Ask fellow Aislings, or visit the library (( www.darkages.com/community ))

Choices.Text: I am not sure about the mundane locations

Dialog.Name: Riona
Dialog.Text: You know that a memory set cannot be altered without extreme hardship and agony (( -100,000 Experience! ))

Dialog.Name: Riona
Dialog.Text: I will ask you how old you are, but first, let me know which season you were born in

Dialog.Name: Riona
Dialog.Text: How old are you now? As you may know, a mundane cannot become an Aisling before his 12th birthday, nor after the 40th birthday.

Dialog.Name: Riona
Dialog.Text: Which land were you born in?

Choices.Text: I've made some error, excuse me.

Dialog.Name: Riona
Dialog.Text: Hello.  What can I do for you?

Dialog.Name: Riona
Dialog.Text: You've already given me your birth information. I cannot possibly alter it. Did you remember it incorrectly? That would be so difficult to change. It would mean that your memory is not correct, too ((up to -100,000 experience points))
